name: routebench
description: Local-first CLI for benchmarking and comparing LLM models behind an OpenAI-compatible router endpoint.

scripts.bench:opencode: node src/cli.js run --preset opencode-free --output results/opencode-results.json --report results/opencode-report.md --route-output results/opencode-routing.json
scripts.bench:opencode-code: node src/cli.js run --preset opencode-free-code --benchmark benchmarks/claude-code-compat.json --output results/opencode-code-results.json --report results/opencode-code-report.md --route-output results/opencode-code-routing.json
scripts.bench:code-compat: node src/cli.js run --benchmark benchmarks/claude-code-compat.json --output results/code-compat-results.json --report results/code-compat-report.md
scripts.bench:frontier: node src/cli.js run --preset opencode-free-frontier --benchmark benchmarks/frontier.json --output results/frontier-results.json --report results/frontier-report.md --route-output results/frontier-routing.json
scripts.bench:code-assistant: node src/cli.js run --preset opencode-free-code-assistant --benchmark benchmarks/code-assistant.json --output results/code-assistant-results.json --report results/code-assistant-report.md --route-output results/code-assistant-routing.json
scripts.bench:polyglot: node src/cli.js run --benchmark benchmarks/polyglot-hard.json --output results/polyglot-results.json --report results/polyglot-report.md --route-output results/polyglot-routing.json
